premise: On a cool cloudy morning Turtle is too chilly to do anything but crawl, so she climbs onto the log and waits; when the sun comes out she stretches out long and warm, and Beetle shines beside her.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The North Wind and the Sun' made tiny: no hurry and no shove — the sun does it, gently.
lesson: Some things can't be hurried; a friend waits with you.
learning: Turtles warm themselves up by lying in the sun.

en-US.title: Turtle Warms Up
en-US.text: {log:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.7} {sfx:breeze} [softly] It was a cool, cloudy morning in the valley. {turtle:enter} Turtle was so chilly {turtle:tint #9AD0FF 1.5s} that everything felt slow. Even slower than usual. {beetle:enter} {beetle:go to turtle} Beetle came scuttling up. {beetle:face happy} [playfully] "Come and play!" {turtle:live shake-head} "Too cold," said Turtle. "I need the sun first." {beetle:face sad} But the sun was hiding behind the clouds. So Turtle {turtle:go on log} crawled, very slowly, up onto the old log. {log:live creak} {sfx:creak} It gave a little creak. [curious] "Why up there?" asked Beetle. "To be ready," said Turtle. And she waited. {beetle:wobble} Beetle waited too. Then… {canvas:clouds stop} the clouds drifted away, {canvas:sunshine 0.9} and out came the sun. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live sunbathe hold} Turtle stretched out her neck and her legs, long and warm, and closed her eyes. [sighs] Ahhh. {beetle:face happy} {beetle:go on log} Beetle climbed up beside her, {beetle:live shine} and his shell shone green and gold. [warmly] "Warm enough to play now?" "Mmm," said Turtle. "In a minute." {beetle:hearts} And Beetle stayed right there with her, shining in the sun. {canvas:sunshine stop}

es-ES.title: Tortuga entra en calor
es-ES.text: {log:enter} {canvas:clouds 0.7} {sfx:breeze} [softly] Era una mañana fresquita y gris en el valle. {turtle:enter} Tortuga tenía tanto frío {turtle:tint #9AD0FF 1.5s} que todo le salía despacio. Aún más despacio que de costumbre. {beetle:enter} {beetle:go to turtle} Escarabajo llegó correteando. {beetle:face happy} [playfully] —¡Ven a jugar! {turtle:live shake-head} —Tengo frío —dijo Tortuga—. Primero necesito el sol. {beetle:face sad} Pero el sol estaba escondido detrás de las nubes. Así que Tortuga {turtle:go on log} se subió al viejo tronco, despacito, despacito. {log:live creak} {sfx:creak} El tronco crujió un poquito. [curious] —¿Por qué ahí arriba? —preguntó Escarabajo. —Para estar preparada —dijo Tortuga. Y esperó. {beetle:wobble} Escarabajo esperó también. Y entonces… {canvas:clouds stop} las nubes se apartaron, {canvas:sunshine 0.9} y salió el sol. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live sunbathe hold} Tortuga estiró el cuello y las patas, bien largas, y cerró los ojos. [sighs] Aaah. {beetle:face happy} {beetle:go on log} Escarabajo trepó a su lado, {beetle:live shine} y su caparazón brilló verde y dorado. [warmly] —¿Ya tienes calor para jugar? —Mmm —dijo Tortuga—. Dentro de un ratito. {beetle:hearts} Y Escarabajo se quedó allí con ella, brillando al sol. {canvas:sunshine stop}

breeze.prompt: a cool, quiet morning breeze over a grassy valley, soft and still, realistic field recording

creak.prompt: an old hollow wooden log creaking softly as a small animal climbs onto it, realistic, close
